run_train_net: run the detectron2 training script with a config file to train a detection model
run_train_net_eval_only: run the detectron2 training script in eval-only mode to test a pre-trained model
build_evaluator: build an evaluator for a given dataset using the config and dataset name
test_with_TTA: test a model with test-time augmentation using the Trainer class method
setup_config: setup and load a detectron2 config from a file with command-line overrides
